comparison.topic: Terrorism charges against an Ann Widdecombe murder suspect

mirror.emphasis: Daily Mirror foregrounds the suspect's name and age alongside the terror charges involving Nigel Farage, attributing the information to Counter Terrorism Policing.

gbnews.emphasis: GB News foregrounds the terror charges against Nigel Farage while providing the suspect's name and age.

comparison.topic: State pension triple lock policy changes
agreed_facts: Andy Burnham plans to scrap the state pension triple lock
